chapter: Big band, Chicago players, recordings and gospel
title: After-hours gatherings and Von Freeman's sessions
summary: South Side entertainers have always gathered after hours; today Von Freeman holds sessions.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, that's an old South Side tradition, isn't it? Entertainers gathering in some place after hours on on or off nights.
Right, right. They have it right now, Von Freeman, he has his sessions out here.
I was just over to his house.
Oh, well, right, well, he has one, and there are ones that they go by and blow and have a ball on Monday nights.
Yeah, there are a lot of people that think Von is one of the great tenor saxophone --
Chicago is still a good breeding ground.
